description:
Team Photons 3M is a passionate group of aspiring scientists and innovators united by a vision to explore the universe. For the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we aim to combine physics, AI, Machine Learning, and programming to solve real-world space challenges. Through teamwork, creativity, and NASA's open data, we aspire to develop innovative solutions, learn new skills, and contribute to space exploration.

Equinox: One Team, One Vision, Infinite Possibilities!
